key_interactions.effect: Profound sedation and respiratory depression (label boxed warning).
key_interactions.action: Limit dose and duration; monitor closely for respiratory depression and sedation.

key_interactions.effect: Additive CNS depression, including fatal respiratory depression (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid alcohol; use caution with other CNS depressants.
Consider a lower diazepam dose; avoid grapefruit.
Consider a higher dose by response.
